svg.title: Primary Cilium — Bent projection
svg.desc: A curved primary cilium with continuous surface membrane, an axonemal cue and a basal body. A longitudinal primary-cilium schematic, not a motile cilia brush border. Microtubule number, ciliary pocket geometry, length, bending mechanics, transition zone and species are not specified.
